name: John Kiefer
role: Medora resident; groom in Medora's first marriage
bio: John Kiefer married Mary Jane Corcoran in July 1884, which the paper celebrated as Medora's first marriage. His wife's poor health took them east that fall and winter in search of medical care, and she had nearly recovered by February 1885. In 1885 he built a house on Third Avenue and was subpoenaed as a witness in Wm. Roberts' case at Miles City. In 1886 the Northern Pacific Refrigerator Car Company foreclosed a $1,327.53 mortgage against John and Mary J. Kiefer, and his former building became the school.
